title: Concentrated Portfolios Win
primary_theme: LP preference for concentrated, thoughtful emerging manager portfolios
founder_lessons: Do not assume being a successful founder or angel automatically makes someone a good GP.
Spend enough time getting to know founders before committing capital.
Concentrated portfolios can serve LPs who already diversify across many firms and funds.
Good people who are also smart create the strongest LP conviction.
notable_quotes: I can diversify on my own. I want the GPs to choose the right ones.
Oh, I was a really good founder. I was a really good angel investor. Of course I'm going to be a good general partner.
